name: Push Pull Legs, Six Days
description: Push, pull and legs twice a week each, six days on and one day off, for 12 weeks. The first round of the week is built around the bench press, the deadlift and the back squat, the second around the overhead press, the barbell row and the front squat. For lifters with time to train most days; week 9 is a deload.
